assumptions.statement: The site boundary is a repository-provided provisional rough polygon, not an official redline.
assumptions.impact: All spatial metrics and partitions are conceptual and must be recalculated after official polygon replacement.

assumptions.statement: The three provisional key-area polygons are area-calibrated north-to-south placeholders and are not station-, road-, parcel-, or heritage-boundary anchored.
assumptions.impact: Review key-area spatial prototypes as typologies only; precise station integration and project siting are deferred.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, engineering constraints, and investment conditions are missing.
assumptions.impact: FAR, height, density, statutory green ratio, parking, demolition quantities, and investment remain unknown.

assumptions.statement: Nine building footprints are prototype placeholders generated inside provisional key areas.
assumptions.impact: They test spatial relationships only and are not an existing-building survey or new-build/demolition commitment.

assumptions.statement: Precise Juesheng Temple/Dazhongsi heritage protection polygons, view corridors, and height controls are not in the site package.
assumptions.impact: No deterministic heritage-adjacent massing, height, or public-space intervention is proposed.

assumptions.statement: Power, telecom, charging, fire, drainage, waste, loading, and edge-compute capacities are unknown.
assumptions.impact: New-infrastructure items are disconnectable interface principles, not engineering capacity claims.

assumptions.statement: Projects, policy tools, landmarks, events, operators, funding, and dates are reference proposals.
assumptions.impact: They do not represent approval, procurement, government commitment, or guaranteed delivery.

assumptions.statement: Trees, rivers, flood controls, levels, sponge facilities, and underground utilities require official and field evidence.
assumptions.impact: The green layer is a conceptual continuity test, not existing-condition or statutory green evidence.

assumptions.statement: Package self-check, content review eligibility, and professional scoring eligibility are distinct states under active repository discussion.
assumptions.impact: This submission reports validator outputs factually and does not pre-judge maintainer or jury decisions.
